summary: Enhance your managerial skills with our Data Analytics for Managers Training Course. Learn to leverage data for informed decision-making and strategic insights.
lede: Data Analytics for Managers equips professionals to turn operational data into clear decisions, practical actions, and measurable results. Using Excel, Power BI, KPI frameworks, dashboard interpretation, trend analysis, and data quality checks, you will learn to identify performance drivers and test assumptions with confidence. You will practise building KPI trees, applying segmentation and variance analysis, and creating concise action summaries for stakeholders. The course also introduces balanced scorecard thinking, data governance routines, and responsible AI-assisted analytics while keeping the focus on practical management decisions, accountability, and credible reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for managers and adjacent professionals who need to interpret operational data, supervise reporting routines, and brief stakeholders with confidence.
outcomes: Dashboard Design In Power BI Tableau
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working familiarity with spreadsheets and routine management reporting. You should be comfortable reading tables, charts, and basic performance metrics. No programming is required, and advanced statistics are introduced only at a practical management level. Recommended preparation: bring a laptop, a recent management report or dashboard, and a sample KPI set from your work context if available. If your organization uses Microsoft Excel, Power BI, or Tableau, the course exercises can be aligned to your existing reporting workflow.
